{"notes": "Visit 1 (0:00-1:00): Priya set direction fast (big simple fish facing left, clear delegation: Tom top line + start domino, Maya bottom line, Priya tail, Leo tray). Tom and Maya agreeable and went for dominoes. Leo silent, no output seen.

Visit 2 (ending 2:45): Picture: dark chain connected to start runs along the bottom line only, to about x=14. The pale top line is fully laid out to about x=23.5 but NOT connected. Its nose end sits just short of the start chain, with a small gap. No tail visible yet. Only the bottom line is currently live. Don't know who placed which dominoes, so credit for the top line is unattributed.

Priya: Spotted the connection problem herself and said she's fixing it at the nose. Good ownership and honest status. She is now hands-on rather than only sketching, which resolves my earlier worry. Also redirected Tom to the upper tail. Leadership solid. Check that the join actually lands and the tail gets built.

Maya: Bottom line is progressing and connected to start, about halfway. She said she'll shout when it reaches the tail, which is good communication. Credited Leo. Execution looks reliable. Need her to keep pace, as the line still has roughly 9 units to go.

Tom: Heard nothing from him this visit. Unclear whether he laid the top line (it exists, and was his job) or what he's doing now. Priya had to point him at the upper tail. Still unverified. Ask what he built.

Leo: Maya thanked him at 2:00, so he apparently contributed something (probably supply or tray). I didn't see what. Still quiet, so treat as positive but unconfirmed. Ask him directly.

No ratings yet. Watch: top line joining to start, tail connection, whether the whole fish is linked before the push."}
